---
title: API reference
---

## Entrypoints

- `sample(*, model=None, until=None, initial_strategy=None, progress=True, dashboard=False, control=None, on_event=None, nuts_sampler=None, **sample_kwargs) -> InferenceData | DataTree`: synchronous local sample; all remaining keywords pass to the sampler.
- `start(...) -> SamplingHandle`: identical parameters, runs in a background thread.
- `iter_sample(model, sample_kwargs, *, nuts_sampler=None, until=None, initial_strategy=None, control=None, sample_fn=None)`: yields `PhaseUpdate`, `SamplingProgress`, `ConvergenceUpdate`, `RunFinished`; the generator's return value is `SamplingResult(idata, report, effective_sampler, requested_sampler)`. Both sampler names are also in the attached final report.
- `RunControl(stop_requested=None)` accepts a zero-argument external stop predicate. `.is_stop_requested()` invokes it at most every 0.5 seconds and latches true; `.stopped` reads the thread-safe local flag. `.request_stop()` requests a cooperative stop. Poll failures warn once without aborting sampling; `poll` and `stop` remain aliases. JAX cannot abort a running kernel.
- `SamplingHandle.wait(timeout=None)`, `.stop()`, `.close()`, `.done`, `.snapshot()`, `.dashboard_url` manage a background run.
- `check_convergence(idata, until=True, *, var_names=None) -> dict`: independently assess any ArviZ 0.x InferenceData / 1.x DataTree.
- `read_report(idata) -> dict | None`: read the report attached to `posterior.attrs`.
- `normalize_target(until) -> dict | None`: validate a policy and expand defaults.

## Caching integration

`sample.__pymc_cache_normalize__(model, kwargs)` takes exactly two positional arguments and returns exactly four fields:
`call_kwargs` (executable keyword arguments excluding the separately passed model, preserving `nuts_sampler=None` and omitted/default `tune` for automatic fallback), `key_kwargs` (resolved sampler inputs and normalized policy, excluding display and the separately identified model), `sampler_identity`, and `versions`. It does not
import or depend on the cache package. Live controls, native callbacks and event callbacks cannot be cached and raise `ValueError` when passed to the normalizer. Execution and normalization use the same resolver: equivalent omitted/explicit draw, warmup, chain and policy defaults produce equivalent keys, while `call_kwargs` retains the caller's automatic sampler and warmup intent. Sampler dependencies are included in `versions` (including JAX libraries for JAX samplers).

The full generated object reference lives in [Generated API reference](reference/index.qmd).

## Policy keys

`r_hat`, `ess`, `mcse`, `quantiles`, `divergences`, `bfmi`, `treedepth`,
`var_names`, `patience`, `growth`, `futility`, `escalate`, `superchains`.
Unknown names and invalid values raise. Automatic escalation retries
warmup, target acceptance, adaptation (nutpie), or draw cap as indicated by
the diagnosed failure, retaining attempt history in the final report.
